campaign: TileLang-Weft performance inheritance; target-native source JIT and alternating native controls

compiler_change_audit.scope: All 553 selected author programs lower and emit through the shared compiler. Source/Physical audits identify affected paths for installed-package reruns; unchanged observations retain their original artifact and package evidence.
shared_repairs: bounded indexed-producer overlap in grouped reduction scheduling

unchanged_riscv_emission.scope: Matched old/new compilation of all 406 selected RISC-V Canonical programs
unchanged_riscv_emission.x86: Both repairs are confined to the RISC-V target. Its existing LLVM and native evidence is retained.

compiler_change_audit.new_matrix_consumer: K1 Q2_K whole-record I8 panel: target-native JIT, numerical checks and cache restoration pass; alternating complete-workload native pair 976.196175 ms versus Triton 1446.993895 ms. Activation quantization, panel population and correction remain inside each call.

numeric_conversion_repair.consumer: A staged F32 lookup table preserves the intermediate numeric SEW/LMUL and receives the gather capacity through an explicit representation conversion.

final_selected_scope.basis: The final installed TileLang frontend reimports the original TIRx function from each selected source-JIT artifact and lowers it with the released shared core. No text IR round trip is used. Affected native bodies have fresh source-JIT checks and exact artifact-matched alternating pairs; unchanged bodies retain their original observations.
final_selected_scope.status: 553 selected programs match the final emitted body; qualifier-only differences add readonly restrict facts while existing writers already carry restrict

compiler_change_audit.new_row_consumer: K3 IQ4_XS runtime row: typed U8 lookup indices and explicit I32 intermediary, original record snapshots retained. Alternating exact installed-JIT native artifact pair 8.7010655 ms versus Triton 8.6255695 ms.

reduction_repair.source: physical partial-set slots, register liveness and VL/VTYPE state work
reduction_repair.ratio: TileLang native time / retained Triton native time

immutable_seed_repair.source: The selected widening reduction uses a pure read-only RVV zero intrinsic instead of reinitializing that value inside opaque assembly. LLVM can hoist or reuse its SSA value. No author numerical group or Level changes.
immutable_seed_repair.status: affected installed-package validation and exact artifact-matched native pairs passed
immutable_seed_repair.indexed_supply: When the complete independent live set fits, a bounded typed producer walk preserves intrinsic scheduling for indexed entry loads. This keeps lookup supply and reduction overlap visible to LLVM; the selected physical operations retain their declared numerical groups and lifetimes.

measurement.ratio: matched reference native time / TileLang native time
measurement.native: complete recorded workload; cold JIT and Python calls separate
measurement.cold: compilation plus first full workload call; compiler API time is also recorded
measurement.cache: fresh-process restoration and invocation; original cache events retained
measurement.numerical_checks: exact serialized fields and integers; established floating tolerances; projection decode checks all columns, prefill checks64 outputs and all-output finiteness
measurement.triton: TileLang native time / Triton native time; alternating samples on shared inputs; per-case ratio <= 1.03

selection: Explicit observation selection by case; checked source-JIT artifact matched to its alternating native pair; no minimum-time selection.

ggml-cpu-rvv.revision: Retained source snapshot and compile database identify each fixed build; no unrecorded commit is inferred.
ggml-cpu-rvv.workloads: Quantized dot/rows, quantize/dequantize, projection, normalization, RoPE, softmax and dense computation
ggml-cpu-rvv.boundary: Native leaf or full prepared graph, exactly as recorded by each case
ggml-cpu-rvv.build: Clang 23, Release -O3, native ISA/VLEN, normal repack and available vendor features retained

ggml-cpu-x86.boundary: Selected native function or complete model-default projection
ggml-cpu-x86.build: Clang 23, Release -O3, native x86 ISA; AMX-named buffer does not prove AMX instructions

ggml-ime1.boundary: Packed M4/M1 row tile; persistent preparation outside both measurements
ggml-ime1.build: Same recorded GGML source and normal IME1 build as the corresponding baseline

ggml-ime2.boundary: Signed I8 packed M4/M1, N32, K512; Q6_K/Q8_0 storage contract
ggml-ime2.build: Clang 23 and compatible external assembler; A100 registration before affinity

ggml-ime2-i4-affine.entry: spacemit_kernels::ime2::gemm_kernel_i8i4, block32 affine M4 integer branch
ggml-ime2-i4-affine.boundary: Packed U4 weights and I8 activations, exact I32 products followed by F32 scale/update; two M4 calls cover an M8 window
ggml-ime2-i4-affine.build: Same retained vendor reference library and external assembler as the IME2 I8 cases

openblas.boundary: LP64 SGEMM X[M,K] times W[N,K] transpose

onednn.boundary: Plain-stride matmul execute plus wait, internal packing included; strict F32

llama-normal.boundary: Prefill and decode separately; loading, compilation and startup excluded
llama-normal.build: Retain normal repack, OpenMP and configured vendor backend; source and runtime policy per model
llama-normal.note: K3 CPU/RVV and vendor IME2 are separate reference policies

binding_validation.scope: Actual installed source module, factory, parameters, physical options, toolchain, typed arguments, grid and thread count matched to the formal catalog. Paired native library and generated program matched byte-for-byte to that checked source JIT artifact.

triton_control_corrections.reason: The retained controls overflowed on I8 -128 negation. The same retained Triton Canonical program was rebuilt after the exact signed-I8 reduction repair; the endpoint check now passes. Historical samples remain separate.
